local L = game:GetService('Lighting')
local out = {string.format('Lighting: Brightness=%.2f ClockTime=%.1f Ambient=%s OutdoorAmbient=%s FogEnd=%.0f GlobalShadows=%s EnvDiffuse=%.2f EnvSpecular=%.2f', L.Brightness, L.ClockTime, tostring(L.Ambient), tostring(L.OutdoorAmbient), L.FogEnd, tostring(L.GlobalShadows), L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale, L.EnvironmentSpecularScale)}
for _, c in ipairs(L:GetChildren()) do
  local s = c.ClassName .. ' ' .. c.Name
  if c:IsA('Atmosphere') then s = s .. string.format(' density=%.2f offset=%.2f haze=%.2f glare=%.2f color=%s', c.Density, c.Offset, c.Haze, c.Glare, tostring(c.Color)) end
  if c:IsA('BloomEffect') then s = s .. string.format(' int=%.2f size=%d thr=%.2f', c.Intensity, c.Size, c.Threshold) end
  if c:IsA('ColorCorrectionEffect') then s = s .. string.format(' bright=%.2f contrast=%.2f sat=%.2f tint=%s', c.Brightness, c.Contrast, c.Saturation, tostring(c.TintColor)) end
  table.insert(out, s)
end
return table.concat(out, '\n')
